##: The manifest that is seeded, once and by hand, into ruslan-rv-ua/scoop-bucket as
bucket/tapir.json (docs/release.md, section «Засівання bucket»). After that the
bucket's own Excavator bumps the live copy: it reads `checkver` and `autoupdate`
below, finds the newest release and lifts the hash from the `.sha256` sidecar.
Nothing in this repository edits the bucket, and no token crosses between them.
The release asset is `tapir-v<version>-x64.exe`; the `#/tapir.exe` fragment renames
the download so `bin` and `shortcuts` stay stable across versions.
build/releaseShape.test.ts holds this URL and .github/workflows/release.yml together.
`persist` carries both folders Tapir keeps beside the exe. Under scoop they would
otherwise live inside the versioned app directory, which `scoop cleanup` and
`scoop uninstall` delete — and `recordings` is what the app exists for.
`hash` is a placeholder until the first release exists to hash; the seeding step
replaces it with the sidecar's value.
description: Accessible Internet Radio Recorder for Windows
